name: Tokimeki Memorial 2 Substories: Leaping School Festival
summary: A follow-up to Tokimeki Memorial 2, Leaping School Festival is set in the fall of the second year of high school. Just one day before the school festival, Mei and Homura banter about who's the better gamer, and the protagonist is caught in the debate. Akane was also there and became involved. The protagonist gets to know their inner feelings and private lives during the school festival.
